accessibility.evidence: Rendered header/footer landmarks and a labeled command list retain text captions. Keyboard Tab shows a visible solid focus outline in the dashboard. Browser measurements check full command text and header bounds; no interactive controls are added to the broadcast frame.

responsive.evidence: Chromium checks the 1080x1920 broadcast, 390x844 phone, 1440x900 dashboard and narrow dashboard. All ten commands and both complete vote arguments remain visible; the office is exactly 75% of the stage, the footer reaches its bottom, and no command cards or stage rows overlap or create horizontal scrolling. See chrome-checks.json.

loading.evidence: Held the lazy 3D chunk: the loading status and all ten footer commands remain visible in chrome-loading.png.

empty.evidence: An isolated zero-player snapshot shows the !join instruction and the empty leaderboard caption without hiding commands; chrome-empty.png.

error.evidence: Blocked the socket and aborted the 3D chunk: the header says disconnected, the office offers WebGL/reload recovery guidance, and all commands remain visible; chrome-disconnected.png.

partial.evidence: Ten employees with an empty leaderboard still render the office and a safe top-drama placeholder; chrome-partial.png.

success.evidence: Mocked snapshots show ten employees, day 999, a long Vietnamese top-drama name and simulator/LIVE badges. Full command text fits in the measured stage and preview layouts; chrome-1080.png and chrome-390.png.

permission.evidence: A clean dashboard browser context has no admin token and its Tung drama control stays disabled. No admin actions or mutations are sent to the running server; chrome-dashboard-1440.png.

renderedEvidence.observation: Populated 3D office, restyled scoreboard header and complete command board at the bottom.
Portrait phone view retains all commands, full vote arguments and the LIVE badge; the fixed 9:16 stage is letterboxed inside the taller viewport.
Dashboard preview uses the same header/footer and retains locked admin controls.
Narrow dashboard preview has no horizontal scrolling or overlapping command cards.
Empty office retains a join instruction and the full footer.
Available employees remain visible when the leaderboard is empty.
3D loading does not displace the header or command footer.
Disconnected and failed-3D states keep the complete command board and show recovery guidance.

limits: Snapshots and socket messages are mocked locally, not real TikTok events.
No claim about physical GPU frame rate, OBS capture or TikTok delivery latency.
